concepts.name: 코랄 작업실
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original environment concept painting for HEXBLADE, a 3D quarter-view sci-fi shooting game; first art direction study BEFORE modeling or texture implementation.
Primary request: paint an appealing, cohesive, richly art-directed sci-fi maintenance room whose floor, walls and furniture all feel deliberately hand-painted, to replace a bland modular environment. This is a complete scene illustration, NOT a UV atlas or diagram.
Composition: a single wide landscape image, approximately 3:2. Elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera looking into an open-front 8x8m room with L-shaped rear and left walls. Entire room fits with a modest margin, occupies most of the image, on a quiet dark indigo backdrop. Spacious upper main deck, shallow lower foreground machinery deck. Include broad beveled wall panels, one workbench with drawer pedestals, one tall two-door cabinet, wall-mounted cooling unit and electrical cabinet, and two cylindrical tanks linked by a thick elbow pipe on the lower deck. These are the actual categories of the existing game's room. Large, chunky, slightly asymmetrical silhouettes, readable at game scale. Keep the central roughly 45 percent of the floor open for gameplay, but beautifully paint its large panel shapes and surface transitions. Perimeter details can be denser. No characters.
Style: premium hand-painted game environment concept art, deliberate broad painterly strokes, sculpted painted bevel light, cool colored shadows, subtle hand-drawn edge variation, carefully chosen scuffs and relief markings, nonphotorealistic opaque painted surfaces. Make the painted surfaces the visual star. Distinct materials and regional color rhythms, avoid flat repetitive boxes. Interesting floor composition without visual noise. Restrained lights; surface painting must remain legible without relying on glow.
Avoid: photorealism, generic glossy 3D render, graybox, excessive neon, thick black comic outlines everywhere, gritty fine noise, endless identical tiles, fantasy forest, floating holograms, text, logos, watermarks, UI, arrows outside the scene, comparison panels, swatch strips, split screens.
Specific direction A: warm inhabited craft workshop in a space cleaning company's base. Dominant muted plum / blue-violet floor and steel wall bodies, clay-coral painted worktop and cabinet handles, selective cream enamel panels, small warm apricot work lights. Wide mauve floor plates with irregular cool lavender brushed patches and a faded terracotta U-shaped service lane around the open center; two inset drainage strips, controlled paint chips at traffic edges. Walls have broad cream-violet inset plates with raised dark-violet frames and coral diagonal corner motifs painted onto selected panels, chunky pipe clamps. One hanging tool rail and folded cleaning cloth at the workbench, grouped containers at room edges. Warm pool of light around the workbench opposed by cool lower-deck shadows. Inviting, tactile, hand-painted, attractive even with no characters; warm/cool harmony and a strong coral focal point.

Specific direction C: retro-futurist cream-enamel cleaning and maintenance dock, playful but practical. Dominant warm ivory wall and cabinet faces, deep dusty blueberry structural frames, muted celadon machinery and restrained salmon-red hardware, soft lilac shadows. Art direction noticeably different from A and B, higher-key surfaces but still subdued game floor. Floor is blue-lilac industrial slab panels with large sweeping brushed color transitions, a broad faded cream service pad only near the rear workbench, painted salmon corner brackets and localized maintenance hatch designs. Walls feature asymmetrical large cream panels, chunky round vents and charming rounded inset access doors, celadon pipework. Upper rear workbench has cream drawer pedestals and a salmon worktop, pale-green tall cabinet, small neatly grouped cleaning bottles and a coiled hose at the edge. Lower deck tanks are cream and celadon, pipe bands salmon, deep blueberry grate shadows. Painted enamel chips reveal lilac undercoat rather than rusty brown, soft edge highlights and obvious human-looking broad brushwork. Visually charming, clear shapes and carefully authored surface motifs; never sterile white hospital, never toy plastic.
